settings.ceo_bio:
For twenty years, DADO has been shaping the culture of ceramics in Uzbekistan. To us, tile is not merely a building material but a foundation that gives a space its character and keeps its appearance for years. The ROMA, ITALICA, GRESART and SEVEN brands were created with exactly this outlook.

The trust of our clients is our greatest value. We approach every order with care, from quality control to delivery and follow-up advice. We look forward to welcoming you to the DADO showroom and finding the right solution for your home or project together.
settings.ceo_bio_uz:
Yigirma yil davomida DADO O‘zbekistonda keramika madaniyatini shakllantirib kelmoqda. Biz uchun plitka shunchaki qurilish materiali emas, balki makonga xarakter beradigan, yillar davomida o‘z ko‘rinishini saqlaydigan asosdir. ROMA, ITALICA, GRESART va SEVEN brendlari aynan shu qarash asosida yaratilgan.

Mijozlarimizning ishonchi bizning eng katta qadriyatimizdir. Biz har bir buyurtmaga mas’uliyat bilan yondashamiz: sifat nazoratidan tortib, yetkazib berish va keyingi maslahatgacha. Sizni DADO showroomida ko‘rishdan va uyingiz yoki loyihangiz uchun eng to‘g‘ri yechimni birga topishdan mamnun bo‘lamiz.

Доверие наших клиентов — наша главная ценность. Мы ответственно подходим к каждому заказу: от контроля качества до доставки и последующих консультаций. Будем рады видеть вас в шоуруме DADO и вместе подобрать наиболее подходящее решение для вашего дома или проекта.

brand.name: ROMA
brand.subtitle: CERAMICS · Italian classic
brand.tagline: Marble elegance, a style proven by time
brand.hero_subtitle: Collections that preserve the beauty of natural stone in porcelain stoneware.
brand.about_text:
ROMA collections draw on the classic motifs of Italian architecture: white and beige marble, warm travertine, soft limestone. Veins and colour transitions are reproduced with the naturalness of real stone, so the interior never feels heavy.

The brand offers a single colour system for floors and walls: within one collection, large-format porcelain stoneware, wall tile and decor elements are coordinated. This helps bring a project to a coherent finish.

history.title: The birth of the ROMA brand
history.text: DADO introduced a dedicated brand devoted to classic Italian style. The first collections consisted of 300×600 and 600×600 formats in white and beige marble looks.

history.title: Large format and polished surfaces
history.text: Polished porcelain stoneware in the 600×1200 format was added to the collections. This opened ROMA to wide use in hotel and public-interior projects.

history.title: Stone and decor line
history.text: The brand expanded with structured tiles in travertine and limestone looks and decorative wall tile with classic ornament. Floor, wall and decor can now be selected as one coordinated set within a collection.

news.title: Partnership programme for designers and architects
news.excerpt: DADO launches a partnership programme for interior designers and architects: a sample library, project consultations and the option to meet clients in the showroom.

news.title: Interior trends 2026: what tile has to offer
news.excerpt: Natural textures, calm colours and large formats are the main directions in interior design for 2026. How to find them in the ROMA, ITALICA and GRESART collections.

news.title: Choosing tiles for a bathroom: what to look for
news.excerpt: A bathroom is where humidity, temperature changes and daily use come together. Practical advice on choosing surface, format and colour.

news.title: Caring for porcelain stoneware: simple rules
news.excerpt: Porcelain stoneware is one of the most durable finishes, yet proper care keeps its look for years. A short guide to daily cleaning and joints.
